source_document: Baltia Airlines / Swissport USA JFK Ground Handling Agreement, Annex B.1.0 (Ramp and Passenger Handling), effective 05/16/2014

kpis.cross_reference_note: Charge covers Annex A ramp-handling clauses listed in Section 1.1.1; Annex A of the Main SGHA (April 2004) is not included in this document, so the underlying service standards cannot be independently verified.
kpis.name: Ramp Handling Charge - B747-200 Turnaround
kpis.description: Fixed ramp handling charge per aircraft turnaround for B747-200 series aircraft, covering the Annex A ramp-handling clauses listed in Section 1.1.1 (Representation/Administration, Ramp Services, Support Services, Security).
kpis.quote: B747-200 series aircraft $2,395.00/turnaround

kpis.cross_reference_note: Charge covers Annex A passenger-handling clauses listed in Section 1.1.2; Annex A is not included in this document, so the underlying service standards cannot be independently verified.
kpis.name: Passenger Service Charge - B747-200 Turnaround
kpis.description: Fixed passenger handling charge per aircraft turnaround for B747-200 series aircraft, covering the Annex A passenger-handling clauses listed in Section 1.1.2.
kpis.quote: B747-200 series aircraft $1,490.00/turnaround

kpis.cross_reference_note: Underlying dispatch service is stated as 'provided by Swiss Intl.' rather than Swissport; Annex A clauses 4.3-4.6 are not included in this document.
kpis.name: Flight Operations/Dispatch Charge - B747-200 Turnaround
kpis.description: Fixed dispatch charge per aircraft turnaround for B747-200 series aircraft, billed by Swissport but noting the underlying dispatch service (Annex A Section 4.3-4.6) is provided by Swiss International Air Lines, not Swissport itself.
kpis.quote: B747-200 series aircraft $280.00/turnaround

kpis.name: Deice Fluid Rate - Type I and Type IV
kpis.description: Per-gallon deicing fluid rates, tiered by fluid type; billing price varies seasonally and the Carrier must inspect and certify the deice was performed to required safety standards.
kpis.quote: Type I (55/45 Glycol/water) $11.50 per gallon applied

kpis.name: Deice Minimum Callout Charge
kpis.description: Minimum charge applied if deicing is requested by the Carrier and subsequently not utilized.
kpis.quote: A minimum callout charge of $150.00 per deice service

kpis.name: Passenger Service Staffing/Manning Commitment
kpis.description: Mutually agreed minimum staffing levels underlying the passenger service pricing: Supervisor, Load Control, Check-in/Gate (B747), Arrivals, and Baggage Service positions with associated man-hours.
kpis.quote: Passenger Service Pricing is based upon the following mutually agreed manning

kpis.cross_reference_note: Off-schedule operations trigger extra labor charges under Paragraph 2.1 and additional-services charges under Paragraph 2.4; no single fixed penalty amount is stated.
kpis.name: On-Schedule Handling Window (+/-60 minutes)
kpis.description: Standard turnaround charges in Paragraph 1.2 apply only when the flight operates within 60 minutes of its scheduled arrival/departure time; deviations beyond this window trigger off-schedule/extra charges under Paragraph 2.
kpis.quote: flights operating within sixty (60) minutes of scheduled arrival or departure

kpis.name: Technical Landing Charge Reduction
kpis.description: Handling for a technical landing for other than commercial purposes (no physical change of load) is charged at 50% of the standard turnaround rates.
kpis.quote: charged at fifty percent (50%) of the above rates

kpis.name: Ramp Return Without Load Change - No Extra Charge
kpis.description: A return from take-off point to ramp is not charged extra, provided no physical change of load is involved.
kpis.quote: will not be charged extra, provided that a physical change of load

kpis.formula: same as technical landing rate (Annex B 1.2.2): 0.5 * standard_turnaround_rate
kpis.cross_reference_note: Cross-references the technical-landing rate defined in Paragraph 1.2.2.
kpis.name: Ramp Return With Load Change - Technical-Landing Rate Applies
kpis.description: A return from take-off point to ramp involving a physical change of load is billed at the same 50% technical-landing rate defined in Paragraph 1.2.2.
kpis.quote: will be charged as for handling in case of technical landing

kpis.name: No Night/Sunday/Holiday Surcharge
kpis.description: No extra charges are made for providing the agreed services at night, on Sundays, or on legal holidays.
kpis.quote: No extra charges will be made for providing the services at night

kpis.name: Port Authority of NY/NJ Pass-Through Fee
kpis.description: Port Authority of NY/NJ fees are billed as a percentage of revenue on all services rendered.
kpis.quote: Port Authority of NY/NJ fees of 5.25% of revenue will be billed

kpis.name: DCS Check-In Fee per Passenger
kpis.description: Carrier must utilize the Handling Company's DCS System for check-in (inclusive of generic bag tags/boarding cards) at a fixed per-passenger rate.
kpis.quote: at a rate of $.95 per passenger

kpis.cross_reference_note: This schedule is the baseline against which the 60-minute on-schedule tolerance in Paragraph 1.2.1 is applied.
kpis.name: Agreed Flight Schedule (ETA/ETD)
kpis.description: Baseline agreed schedule against which the 60-minute on-schedule window (KPI 007) is measured, for Monday/Tuesday/Thursday/Friday/Saturday operations.
kpis.quote: ETA: 1230 L/ETD: 1600L

kpis.name: Extra Labor Rate - Ramp/Cleaning
kpis.description: Hourly rate for extra ramp/cleaning labor when requested/authorized by the Carrier or when flights operate off-schedule.
kpis.quote: Ramp/Cleaning $17.00 per hour

kpis.name: Extra Labor Rate - Passenger Agent
kpis.description: Hourly rate for extra passenger agent labor when requested/authorized by the Carrier or when flights operate off-schedule.
kpis.quote: Pax Agent $18.00 per hour

kpis.name: Extra Labor Rate - CTX Bag Runner
kpis.description: Hourly rate for extra CTX bag runner labor when requested/authorized by the Carrier or when flights operate off-schedule.
kpis.quote: CTX Bag Runner $14.50 per hour

kpis.name: Extra Labor Rate - Supervisor
kpis.description: Hourly rate for extra supervisor labor when requested/authorized by the Carrier or when flights operate off-schedule (single rate; no separate overtime rate listed).
kpis.quote: Supervisor $26.10 per hour

kpis.name: Extra Manpower Minimum Callout (4 Hours)
kpis.description: Extra manpower called in from home may be subject to a four-hour minimum charge if the Handling Company itself incurs a four-hour minimum.
kpis.quote: Extra manpower may be subject to a four (4) hour minimum

cross_reference: MAGSA (Mutual Assistance Ground Services Agreement, ATA)
kpis.cross_reference_note: Benchmark rate source (MAGSA) is an external document not included with this contract; the actual dollar rate cannot be verified without it.
kpis.name: Additional/Uncovered Services Rate (MAGSA-Indexed)
kpis.description: Facilities, equipment, or services requested that are not covered under Paragraph 1.1, or requested when flights operate off-schedule, are charged at 50% of the applicable MAGSA (Mutual Assistance Ground Services Agreement, ATA) published rates.
kpis.quote: shall be charged for at fifty percent (50%) of the applicable rates

kpis.formula: if notice_hours < 12: charge = 0.5 * standard_turnaround_rate; else: charge = 0
kpis.remediation: Provide at least 12 hours' prior notice of cancellation to avoid the 50% charge.
kpis.name: Flight Cancellation Charge
kpis.description: Cancellations are charged at 50% of the standard rates in Paragraph 1.2 unless the Carrier gives at least 12 hours' prior notice.
kpis.quote: Flight cancellations will be charged at fifty percent (50%) of the rates

kpis.name: GPU Air Start Rate
kpis.description: Rate for GPU air start when requested outside Paragraph 1 coverage or during off-schedule operations.
kpis.quote: GPU Air Start $65.00 per hour or part thereof

kpis.name: Heater/Air Conditioner Rate
kpis.description: Rate for heater/air conditioner service, comprising a fixed per-start fee plus an hourly (or part-hour) rate.
kpis.quote: Heater/Air Conditioner $55.00 per start

kpis.name: Disbursement Reimbursement Surcharge
kpis.description: Disbursements made by the Handling Company on behalf of the Carrier are reimbursed at cost plus an accounting surcharge.
kpis.quote: reimbursed by the Carrier at cost price plus an accounting surcharge

kpis.cross_reference_note: Cap applies specifically to liability arising under Article 8.5 of the Main SGHA, which is not included in this document; the full scope of covered incidents cannot be independently verified.
kpis.name: Liability Cap - B747 Incident
kpis.description: Handling Company's liability under Article 8.5 of the Main Agreement is capped for B747-series aircraft incidents.
kpis.quote: not to exceed US $1,000,000/incident

kpis.name: Statutory Cost Pass-Through Adjustment
kpis.description: If the Handling Company's statutory costs increase (payroll taxes, minimum wage, health/unemployment/disability insurance, facility charges, or new payroll/living-wage/service taxes), it may revise and increase rates effective when it starts paying the additional amount.
kpis.quote: will prepare a revision to the rates then in effect

kpis.name: Monthly Prepayment & Reconciliation
kpis.description: Carrier must prepay the monthly estimated amount based on scheduled flights; any shortfall against the actual invoice must be reconciled within 15 days.
kpis.quote: shall provide a prepayment of the anticipated charges

kpis.remediation: Place Carrier on a cash-in-advance basis or suspend/discontinue ground handling services until the account is brought current.
kpis.cross_reference_note: Triggered by the Carrier's failure to pay in accordance with the prepayment terms of Paragraph 9.1.
kpis.name: Non-Payment Remedy - Cash Basis / Service Suspension
kpis.description: If the Carrier fails to pay invoices per Paragraph 9.1, the Handling Company may, at its discretion, place the Carrier on a cash basis or discontinue services until the account is current; this does not constitute breach or termination.
kpis.quote: may, at its discretion, place the Carrier on a cash basis

kpis.name: Late Payment Interest
kpis.description: Invoices not paid in accordance with Paragraph 9.1 accrue monthly interest on the unpaid balance.
kpis.quote: will accrue interest at the rate of one and one-half percent

kpis.remediation: Withhold payment only on the specific disputed invoice item(s); the undisputed balance remains due on the normal schedule.
kpis.remediation_sla: 10 days after resolution of the dispute
kpis.name: Disputed Invoice Item Payment Extension
kpis.description: If the Carrier disagrees with invoice item(s), it may withhold payment only on those items pending resolution; the payment deadline for disputed items is extended.
kpis.quote: deadline for payment for any disputed item(s) will be deemed extended

kpis.name: Contract Term
kpis.description: Overall term of the Annex B ground handling agreement.
kpis.quote: the term of this agreement shall be for a three (3) year period

kpis.name: Annual CPI Rate Escalation (Minimum 3%)
kpis.description: Rates shown are for the first year of service only; thereafter rates increase on each contract anniversary based on CPI, subject to a minimum increase.
kpis.quote: will be subject to an increase each anniversary date of the contract

kpis.consequence_unit: % of employee's annual compensation (salary/wages and benefits)
kpis.name: Non-Solicitation / Employee Hire-Away Compensation
kpis.description: Carrier may not offer employment to the Handling Company's employees during the term or for 6 months thereafter, unless mutually agreed, or must compensate the Handling Company a percentage of the employee's annual compensation.
kpis.quote: will not offer employment to the Handling Company's employees at any time

kpis.cross_reference_note: No SLA has been executed under this clause as of this Annex; if a separate SLA exists elsewhere, it would need to be reviewed separately for measurable service-level KPIs.
kpis.name: Optional Service Level Agreement
kpis.description: A separate SLA may be signed by both parties if requested by mutual agreement; no SLA is included in or executed by this Annex B.
kpis.quote: A service level agreement (SLA) will be signed by both parties, if requested

kpis.quote: 1.1.2 Passenger Handling Services

kpis.cross_reference_note: Lists Annex A clause numbers only; Annex A of the Main SGHA is not included in this document, so service standards/targets cannot be extracted or verified.

kpis.description: List of Annex A ramp/support-services clause numbers governing deicing operations; no standards, targets, or timeframes are stated in this document.
kpis.quote: Ramp Services Section 3.17.2(a); 3.17.3; 3.17.4; 3.17.6
